statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in libpcap 1.10.6, which fixes the error message character encoding mapping from UTF-16 to UTF-8 (listed under Windows in the release notes). This package builds the upstream libpcap 1.10.7 release, which includes that fix. Release notes: https://github.com/the-tcpdump-group/libpcap/blob/libpcap-1.10.7/CHANGES

Fixed upstream in libpcap 1.10.6, which fixes the out-of-bounds read and write in pcap_ether_aton(). This package builds the upstream libpcap 1.10.7 release, which includes that fix. Release notes: https://github.com/the-tcpdump-group/libpcap/blob/libpcap-1.10.7/CHANGES
